# Called it

> Write down the call. Grade it later. A decision journal that shows how often your confidence is right.

Called it is a decision journal for builders. You log a call, such as "this landing page gets 50 sign-ups in a week", with a confidence of 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, or 99 percent and a due date. When the date comes, you grade it right or wrong and can add a one-line note.

A calibration chart shows one point per confidence level: the share of calls you got right against the share you expected. A level appears after 3 graded calls.

Access is by invitation. Called it opens to a few people at a time through a waitlist. It is an r4lph.io product.

## Facts

- Confidence levels: 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, and 99 percent.
- A new call is due in 30 days unless you pick another date.
- Each call is graded once, right or wrong, with an optional one-line note.
- A confidence level shows on the chart after 3 graded calls.
- Calls are private to the account that wrote them.
- Called it does not sell data, show ads, or send journals to AI models. Clerk, Convex, and Vercel run the service.
